acts.q: Curated by Sjraar van Heugten, independent art historian and former Head of Collections at the Van Gogh Museum, Van Gogh and the Seasons is internationally exclusive to Melbourne and presents the largest collection of Van Gogh artworks to ever travel to Australia.
